name: Poisoned Apple
source:
With no past to remember, you live peacefully with your companions in the forest. But as beasts and nightmares emerge, how long can it truly last?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你記不起自己的過去，和同伴們一起在森林裡過著平靜的生活。可當野獸和惡夢接連出現，這樣的日子究竟還能持續多久？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
